rules.title: Inspiration (GM note)
rules.summary: A simple reward the GM hands out for playing a character's personality, ideals, bonds or flaws well. A character either has inspiration or not; spending it gives advantage on one attack roll, saving throw or ability check. Track it on the sheet or with the Inspiration tracker.

rules.title: Calling for checks (GM advice)
rules.summary: Ask for a roll only when the result is uncertain and matters. Name the ability and skill, set the DC (10 easy, 15 medium, 20 hard), and decide before the roll what failure costs. The play guide in table mode lists cues for every skill.

rules.title: Building encounters (GM advice)
rules.summary: The encounter generator is a starting point, not a balance formula: it picks SRD monsters whose challenge rating suits the party's level band and the terrain. Adjust numbers to the party's size and resources, and give every fight a reason, a place that matters and a way out.

procedures.name: Random encounter
procedures.description: Picks SRD monsters for the terrain and the party's level band, what they are doing and an optional twist. Accept to add the encounter and every creature (from its SRD stat block) to the campaign.

procedures.description: A name, an occupation (with an SRD stat block to use if it comes to a fight), a quirk, a voice, what they want and what they hide.
